blurb: Santa Fe Skies is the "Big-Rig-Friendly" RV park of Santa Fe New Mexico! Open since 1999, our park is located on the Turquoise Trail, just south of the city and a 20-minute drive from the historic Santa Fe plaza. Our office is open every day to take reservations and check-ins. Give us a call anytime because making your reservation is FREE. If we don't answer during office hours, we are already on the phone.
